summary.text: Vaguely familiar face is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's immortal disguise killer move. It is the middle step of a three-step series between unfamiliar face and familiar face.

claims.text: While handing unfamiliar face to Fang Yuan, Lang Ya land spirit names the series: unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face. Unfamiliar face is the mortal step; the latter two are immortal killer moves that can hold even when the user takes a familiar person’s form.
How killer moves are built in general is on killer moves.

Feng Jiu Ge demonstrates vaguely familiar face by matching Swordmaster You Lan’s appearance, dao marks, and aura so closely that nearby Gu Immortals take the copy for a twin. He names the move and traces the series to Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable: unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face. Unfamiliar face is a mortal killer move; vaguely familiar face is an immortal killer move with three Immortal Gu as its core, two of them transformation path, and when used deception is hard to tell. Feng Jiu Ge obtained the move in a chance encounter and still needs strong acting: poor tone can expose the transformation. Familiar face does not have that acting flaw. Even imprecise acting does not create sudden strangeness; it can affect others’ perceptions and mentalities so that even a non-existent person feels like a friend or acquaintance.

During the auction for delight in water and mountain Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan has the seller demand a superior identity-disguise killer move. Tai Bai Yun Sheng offers the mortal unfamiliar face; Feng Jiu Ge answers with an incomplete immortal vaguely familiar face from Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. Fang Yuan obtains that incomplete immortal killer move.

Without the original three core Immortal Gu, which remain with Feng Jiu Ge, Fang Yuan uses the light of wisdom and large numbers of star thought Gu to change the core and modify the move around eat strength Immortal Gu. The modified version is greatly simplified and reaches only preliminary success: it cannot change his appearance, but it can change his regional aura among the five regions when he is not fighting at full exertion. Each use consumes several strength path dao marks by turning eat strength on his own strength-path body, so the cost is high and the effect is weaker than some established aura-disguise methods he has seen.
